title: Carbon Lens /api/v2 wire models
description: Public request and response models of the Carbon Lens API. Six status axes are independent and are never merged: job_state, calculation_status, evidence_status, claim.status, passport.status and anchor.status. A missing mandatory input gives q=null with an unavailable_reason; a valid input that the rules of the case take to zero gives q=0 with a zero_reason; a claim of zero is NOT_APPLICABLE, never supported.

Hash.description: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 canonical JSON or over exact file bytes.

Id.description: Opaque identifier. Consumers must not parse it.

Year.description: Model year of the biomass product. This is not the acquisition date of an optical scene.

Fraction.description: A public share, clamped to [0, 1]. Where the arithmetic can land just outside that range, the unclamped value is published beside it.

Warning.description: A machine-stable code with a human message. Consumers switch on code and may localise message; they must not parse message.

Limitation.description: A stated boundary of what the result means. Kept apart from warnings: a limitation always holds, a warning is about this run.

Role.description: What the signed-in person may do. Held on the server and never taken from a request header: a role a client can set is not an authorization.

User.description: The signed-in person. Carries no password material and no session token.

Session.description: An opaque session token and who it belongs to. The token is random, stored only as a hash, and is not derivable from anything in a build.

RiskCode.description: The three risks the supplied data can say something about. There is no aggregate risk score: adding them up would invent a number nobody measured.

Risk.description: An observed basis for a risk, kept apart from q. A risk never adjusts the calculated units; it is shown beside them so a reader can weigh it themselves.

observed.description: Whether the supplied products show the basis at all. False means nothing was found, which is not the same as an established absence.

basis.description: The measured quantities this rests on, copied from the owning product. No score and no probability.

SeriesKind.description: A measured year and a projected year are never the same kind of point, and a chart must not join them into one line.

Projection.description: The baseline trajectory of the case continued to the horizon year. It is a scenario assumption, not a forecast of what the plot will do, and it does not touch the current q.

q_projection.description: Always null. No projection of potential units is made, because nothing in the supplied data supports one.

origin.description: USER_SCENARIO marks a price the caller supplied. It is an input, never a quotation this system stands behind.

ValueScenarios.description: q multiplied by a price, and nothing else. Not a market quote, not a revenue forecast, not a guaranteed sum.

RequestStatus.description: Where a verification request has got to. Only a verifier moves it to FINALIZED, and only from CALCULATED: a failed run and a result that could not produce a number never advance on their own.

VerificationRequest.description: One contour, one period and one stated volume, followed from a draft to a finalized passport. Finalizing pins a particular passport version; it never changes a number.

passport_hash.description: The content hash a verifier pinned when finalizing. A later recalculation produces a new passport and never rewrites this one.

RequestEvent.description: One recorded move of a request. The history is append-only.

VerificationRequestList.description: The requests this role may see: an owner's own, all of them for a verifier, and the finalized ones for an investor.

CreateRequest.description: Either geometry or aoi_id identifies the contour, exactly as in an analysis request.

UpdateRequest.description: What an owner may still change while the request is a draft. The contour and the period are not among them: changing those is a different request.

JobState.description: Progress of the worker only. It says nothing about whether the science produced a number.

EvidenceStatus.description: Quality of the change explanation. Poor optical evidence never by itself sets q=null.

ClaimStatus.description: NOT_APPLICABLE is the answer to a claim of zero: nothing positive was stated, so nothing was supported. A zero claim is never reported as SUPPORTED_BY_CASE.

ClaimOrigin.description: A stated volume is an input label, never a calculated or verified fact.

ClaimMismatchReason.description: NO_POSITIVE_CLAIM accompanies NOT_APPLICABLE: there was nothing positive to compare, which is not a disagreement.

UnavailableReason.description: Mandatory input missing or unusable. The answer is null, never zero.

ZeroUnitsReason.description: Inputs were valid and a rule of the case gives exactly zero units.

ZoneCause.description: What happened and why it happened are separate claims. Absent evidence stays UNKNOWN.

DatasetOrigin.description: STUB_FIXTURE means a typed placeholder adapter answered; it is never real science.

ComparisonResult.description: Version link of the passport, in the vocabulary of the carbon engine that owns passports.

ComparisonDirection.description: How q moved between two comparable observations. A presentational summary, never a verdict on the earlier passport.

PassportStatus.description: State of this passport document. It is not the anchor status: a FINALIZED passport with no blockchain record is the normal case.

WarningSeverity.description: BLOCKING means the finding stopped a value from being published.

SpatialDependence.description: INDEPENDENT_NATIVE_CELLS is the main scenario of the method freeze. FULL_SPATIAL_CORRELATION is published as a separate stress variant and never replaces it.

Geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry in WGS84 lon/lat order.

AnalysisRequest.description: Either geometry or aoi_id identifies the contour. Naming a supplied area is a shortcut for pasting its polygon and changes nothing else.

claimed_units.description: Optional stated volume. It never changes the calculated numbers.

claim_scope.description: Scope the claim refers to. Omitted means the claim is stated for this request.

AreaMeasureRequest.description: A contour to measure before it is submitted. The same geodesic algorithm as the analysis path, so a measurement never disagrees with a run.

AreaMeasurement.description: Measured area of a normalised contour, with the limit it is judged against. An invalid contour is a measurement with valid=false and named errors, not an exception.

Analysis.description: Job progress and, once SUCCEEDED, the typed result. Polling never mixes the axes.

FixtureLabel.description: Present whenever any number came from a labelled vector rather than a computation over data/. The UI must display it.

Run.description: Everything about this particular execution. Kept out of the deterministic content hash on purpose.

requested_ha.description: Geodesic area of the contour that was asked about.

missing_ha.description: max(0, requested - calculated): area the calculation could not cover. Never negative.

area_difference_ha.description: calculated - requested, signed. A small positive value is geodesic arithmetic on cell boundaries, not extra land.

Coverage.description: Four independent coverages. Cloud in an optical scene does not reduce biomass coverage; they are never averaged together.

CoverageFractionRaw.description: Unclamped coverage arithmetic exactly as the owning component reported it. A geodesic area sum over native cells may land a hair above 1.0; that value is preserved here and the public fraction is the clamped one.

Change.description: Stock difference of the accounted pool. The emission figure itself is published exactly once, in units.eproj_tco2e; this block points at it rather than restating it. Positive eproj means a loss from that pool over the period, not an instantaneous release of all its carbon.

eproj_ref.description: Where the single canonical Eproj lives. This block never carries a second copy of it.

eproj_tco2e_ha_year.description: units.eproj_tco2e divided by the normalisation area and the period, for display only.

UncertaintyAssumptions.description: The stated assumptions of the scenario interval, typed so a consumer can display them without guessing. empirically_calibrated is always false: this interval is not calibrated against field measurements.

Uncertainty.description: A scenario interval under stated assumptions. It is not an empirically calibrated confidence interval.

Baseline.description: Scenario baseline of the case from data/methodology/baseline.csv. It does not establish additionality or the owner's effort.

Units.description: Potential units of the case. q=null and q=0 are different answers and carry different reason fields.

ScenarioValues.description: Scenario prices of the case, not a market quote, a revenue forecast or a guaranteed sum.

Claim.description: Comparison of a stated volume with q. gap_value is the scenario value of the unsupported part of the claim; it is not an established loss, a probabilistic Value at Risk or proven fraud.

unsupported_gap.description: max(0, claimed_units - q). Zero when nothing positive was claimed, null when the two are not comparable. An unsupported difference, not an established loss.

Zone.description: A change zone with its share of the stock change. Contributions are shares of one stock difference and are never added to a separately computed fire emission.

artifact_ref.description: The artifact holding this zone's geometry, a GeoJSON FeatureCollection whose features carry zone_id. Non-null whenever zones are published, so a map can draw them without a second contract.

Evidence.description: Quality of the change explanation, separate from whether q could be computed.

Passport.description: Identity of the scientific content and its version link. passport.status and anchor.status are different axes and are never read as one: a passport is FINALIZED by a verifier, an anchor is written by a chain.

Artifact.description: Manifest-listed file. The browser receives an API url, never a filesystem path.

engine_mode.description: REAL means the owning packages answered. FIXTURE means labelled vectors were replayed and every result carries a fixture label; a deployment must opt into it by name.

Anchor.description: A hash anchor detects a changed file against a trusted record. It does not prevent double selling and does not certify that the calculation is true.

Error.description: Error envelope. It never carries a stack trace, a secret or a local filesystem path.
